purpose: Be the machine-readable architectural memory for A-memory meta-interpreter/execution organization.
Keep accepted facts, proved research results, candidates, falsified ideas and open questions explicitly separated.
Carry FORMAL-in-JSON examples showing the intended Link-native structure without host semantic type tags.
Prevent an old research implementation from silently becoming semantic authority.

coreGoal.statement: A complete A-memory state contains everything required to start, pause, serialize, transfer and resume execution. The external substrate supplies only the generalized parallel MP/reaction implementation and no semantic current-context/program-counter pointer.

knownBoundaries.statement: MTS has one Link ontology; Context/Theory/Scope roles are contextual/structural roles, not intrinsic host types.
Generalized reaction preserves 1->0, 1->1, 1->N, N->1 and N->M behavior with explicit reaction semantics.
O is structurally ambiguous as an execution-space sentinel because O = START(R) = Context(R,R) and is also readable as ExactSequence([R]).

In the current direct gauge, C = END(R) is a natural execution-context-space boundary: C itself is not a Context, C-rooted START Context ancestry terminates intrinsically at C, and C-rooted Context chains do not alias ordinary ExactSequence chains.
A concrete entry candidate can be represented by physical existence of K0 = START(C->S0); bare C->S0 is inert, no separate active flag/entry registry is needed for the tested discovery model.

For the tested append-only Context tree, START child growth moves activity to descendants and END(K) closes a branch; sibling START children form a parallel frontier. No deletion of historical Context Links is required.
Frozen A-memory 0.175.0 still receives initial/current Scope and interpreter/Theory from host runtime APIs. This is compatibility behavior, not the desired self-hosted semantic authority.

allowed: execute one generalized parallel reaction law
perform implementation scheduling/parallelization that is observationally equivalent to the reaction law

insideAMemory: meta-interpreter structures once their exact self-hosted form is proved

interpretation.C: execution-context-space END boundary in the direct gauge, not itself a Context

contextCandidate.chiralityNote: C is not promoted to an absolute Foundation-global privilege. v0.14 chirality is Context-relative/covariant; mirror gauge must remain equivalent.

frontierCandidate.testedResearchRule: active leaf = reachable C-rooted Context with no START child and no END closure
frontierCandidate.problem: The tested frontier reader relies on absence checks performed by host traversal. Full self-hosting must prove whether frontier/currentness is derivable by the generalized reaction itself or needs a positive Link-native representation.
frontierCandidate.forbiddenShortcut: Do not reintroduce an external current-scope cursor merely because it is convenient.

reactionCandidate.principle: One reaction consumes one immutable causal snapshot, computes all applicable MP consequences, and atomically publishes the complete successor state.
reactionCandidate.implementationIndependence: The same result must be obtained whether scalar MP instances run sequentially, on CPU threads, on GPU, or on a future associative architecture.

metaInterpreterBoundary.question: Can all meta-grounding/reflection needed for fresh structured inputs be expressed inside the self-contained A-memory and driven by the same generalized reaction, or is extra semantic match/construct power required?
metaInterpreterBoundary.knownFalsifier: Exact S0 grounded MP alone cannot generically bind fresh nested structures and instantiate substituted outputs.

formalJsonExamples.meaning: Bare C->S0 payload exists as data but does not by itself mark an entry.
Physical START lift marks a concrete C-rooted execution entry without a host Context type tag.
Execution growth is represented by child Context structure in the Aset itself.
Parallel branching is represented by multiple child Contexts under one parent.
Branch closure is carried by Link structure, not by host deletion or an active=false flag.

formalJsonRules: Examples are semantic Aset fragments, not JSON metadata schemas.
Object keys are contextual binders/names; string values are FORMAL expressions.
No type=Context, active=true, programCounter, currentPointer or other host semantic tags are permitted.
The ostensive START/END glyphs reuse accepted v0.14 FORMAL structural notation; exact v0.15 surface spelling remains subject to the Author gate.
Document/provenance metadata in this file is outside the embedded semantic Aset fragments and carries no MTS semantic authority.

maintenanceLaw.rule: Any v0.15 decision that changes execution/meta-interpreter organization must update this model in the same change. Research tests/issues may provide evidence but do not silently supersede this model.
maintenanceLaw.authorGate: No C-root choice, frontier rule, meta-grounding power or FORMAL-JSON executable representation becomes accepted without explicit Author confirmation.
